## huawei-cloud-cloudrobo-train 1.0.1

- Initial public release for managing CloudRobo model training and simulation reinforcement learning (SimRL) tasks.
- Supports full lifecycle management: create, read, update, delete, stop, restart, resume, and draft tasks.
- Enables both TRAIN_FROM_SCRATCH (pretrain) and MODEL_TUNING (finetune) workflows with FFT/SFT/LORA/QLORA/DEEPSPEED methods.
- Includes monitoring features: task status, execution stages, resource usage, training logs, events, and failure diagnostics.
- SimRL tasks are managed via the same CLI with a dedicated flag, covering the same operations (except resume).
- Provides detailed usage instructions and workflow guidance for creating and cloning training tasks.
